author: Valve
description:
Steam Frame is here! This video is part two of a two-part series offering a short overview and quick start tips for Valve's streaming-first, wireless VR headset + controllers. Get ready to play your Steam library, whether it's in immersive VR or playing your non-VR games. It supports standalone play, too! 

Learn more here: https://store.steampowered.com/hardware/steamframe
title: Steam Frame: Official Overview and Quick Start Guide (Accessories)
